title: japanese onions dorayaki dumplings jjim
description: nutty, velvety, energizing japanese-style pancakes filled with savory onions, perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
instructions: Combine mung bean paste, onion, turmeric, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and black pepper in a bowl, mixing until well combined.
Heat cornstarch and water in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly until smooth.
Add cornstarch mixture to the mung bean paste mixture and stir until a thick batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Using a ladle, pour a small amount of batter onto the pan and tilt to spread evenly.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Flip the pancake and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
Repeat with remaining batter, adjusting heat as needed to prevent burning.
Serve warm with chopped scallions and a side of soy sauce, if desired.
